GNCL_boundary: Own/aggregate risk mixtures are prior. Inspected GNCL applies one global scalar backward; its aggregation can be raw estimator outputs, so probability/logit pooling and reductions must match before asserting exact equality. It is not the source-masked signed private correction.
blocked_recent_leads: ML-HAN DOI10.1016/j.neucom.2025.131962; Multi-Source Information Graph Embedding DOI10.3390/electronics13142762; counterfactual diversified recommendation DOI10.1016/j.is.2023.102322 remain metadata-only after root HTTP403, with no method conclusion or novelty clearance.
complementarity_boundary: Embedding/attention/input-gradient disagreement, distinct source assignments and correct member labels alone do not establish useful corrected probability mass in the actual full-input committee.
concrete_collision: HGEN independently encodes different meta-path graph evidence and learns fused classifier predictions with an embedding Gram penalty; shared/private factor ownership is separately established by BatchEnsemble. SuGAr independently learns diverse graph selectors. These are direct ingredients, not literal copies of the whole source-supply rule.
exact_training_identity: J=S-A has detached responsibility-weighted factual CE minus detached responsibility-weighted probe CE derivative. Equivalent implementation must retain scalar J, both native pullbacks, reference peers, state/RNG, permissions and finite guards. No duplicate weighted-CE fitted arm is needed.
ownership_boundary: True independent4 means all complete learned parameter objects/storage disjoint. Committee loss coupling is not parameter sharing. A sharing advantage still requires the matched independent counterpart; this analysis alone cannot identify it.

recommendation.contrast: Compare specificity and per-label repair/harm under existing own-only, pool-credit, source-view supervision, COMMON and proposed branches when admitted; no source identity chosen from outcomes.
recommendation.interpretation: Positive U but negligible/negative D means source-supply surrogate utility with redundant/harmful source use in the normal all-full committee. Positive assigned-specific D with favorable native-threshold repair/harm and improved served quality is stronger evidence of classifier-visible complementary source use. It is not causal semantics, geometry novelty or sharing advantage.
recommendation.limits: Fresh current peers differ from frozen training references. No guarantee that assignment yields specificity; source families have unequal strengths. No new selector, strength search, acceptance gate or current execution is authorized.
recommendation.name: Complete member-by-family source utility in two peer contexts
recommendation.population: All permitted heldout VALID rows, all five Bernoulli labels, every member/family/seed of the prospectively admitted branches; fresh selected state in FP32 eval with state custody.
recommendation.required_outputs: p_m^F and p_m^-a for M4 and three fixed families, at current restored member states. Existing complete ablation assay needs16 member/view forwards; matrix arithmetic adds no gradients/forwards if those logits are already retained.
recommendation.risk: R is complete-population mean Bernoulli marginal BCE; score observed positive AND negative label events independently.
recommendation.specificity: Spec(X)=mean assigned diagonal X_ma_m minus mean six off-diagonal X_ma for three active recipients/families; family and recipient additive offsets cancel under the bijection. Report full4x3 matrix including unassigned member, not just this summary.
recommendation.type: one mechanistic analysis; zero additional fitted arms

source_boundary: Raw family removal is a graph-support intervention before native normalization/propagation. The current SeHGNN bank steers precomputed semantic channels; it does not establish new live edge transport or sheaf geometry.
